transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We've got four steel coils — C1, C2, C3, and C4 — sitting at the receiving dock because the labels don't match the mill-certificate packets. Each coil is 300 kilograms, and they're needed for two active production jobs. Before I can make the binding disposition and release any material, I need each of your formal status facts on the record. So let's go through the routine: Quality Assurance, Materials Engineering, Production Control, and Environmental Health and Safety — please each give me your status on these coils so we can get them dispositioned and moving.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My receiving inspection found that the certificate mismatch requires 100% positive-material-identification testing on all four coils before any of them can be released. I completed the inspection this morning, but the inspection worksheet is still waiting to be attached to the receiving record.
